text: Tally, built on Mera.
Sign-up is one button.
Face ID creates a passkey,
Mera returns its P R F output,
and that becomes the account.
No seed phrase, no extension, and the
welcome credit means no gas either.
Coming back is the same gesture.
Mera re-derives exactly the same keys,
on any device where the passkey syncs.
One passkey, three keys.
The owner key changes the rules.
A capped agent key can only
spend inside them.
And a third key signs a café's menu.
When the agent picks something
pricier than the cheapest match, Tally
asks for a fresh Face ID before the
owner key signs the approval.
And the non-wallet use: in merchant
mode, the café owner's passkey signs the
shop's menu every twenty seconds.
All of it lives in one small file,
built on Mera's passkey, signing
session and viem account functions.
Tally.
Your Face ID is your wallet.
